signed_scope: lower bound for 3*G1+G2; deficits subtract from final lower combination

fixed_vs_log_tradeoff.cost: Fixed/fixed eliminates drift but can require a much larger source onset. No numerical N0 is supplied.

budget_order: Adopt fixed C_s,K and fixed exponents/rho.
Choose a positive local pair budget b12.
Fix epsilon0 and eta so (1760/21)*epsilon0+384*C_s*eta<=b12/2. A single shared epsilon is allowed.
Choose A0>2 and B from maximal BV.
Only then take N0 covering source onsets, h ceiling, z>=2, q<=1 and decaying budget b12/2.
source_onset_template: log(N)>=max(log(16),(825000000*B)^2) suffices for the geometric BV condition; other source and error thresholds must still be added.
deduplication: Replace, do not add to, the prior compressed G1/G2 fixed-loss and sieve/BV terms.
No reciprocal-prime-sum or cell multiplicity error: neither is present in these original two sifted sets.
No fixed-mode h error may be silently reintroduced from the comparison mode.
Do not set pending independent-review or remaining analytic gates to zero.
cannot_imply: A local pair threshold is not the common threshold for all twelve terms.
The uniform external source input remains an adopted hypothesis, not a computed fact.
